    Your party

    Level and magic level decide which spells and runes are unlocked. The lure size decides whether area spells are worth a slot. Health potions, mana potions and runes share a 1 s rest, and creatures respawn every 10 s. Regeneration comes from the Build tab: your base regen plus the sockets.

    Creature data from the Tibidle wiki database (game data v198-v242). 327 creatures have full data; creatures marked Unknown type are listed with HP and XP only until their pages are collected. Resistances the wiki does not list are treated as 0%. Spell data from the class guides and the Spells and runes page.
